### Security
- Third-party launchers no longer hand your Anthropic credentials to the provider. When `~/.claude.json` held the Console key saved by `/login` (`primaryApiKey`), or `settings.json` set an `apiKeyHelper`, Claude Code sent that key as `x-api-key` to Z.AI, Kimi, OpenRouter, custom and local endpoints next to the provider's own token; on OpenRouter it also broke third-party models with "No allowed providers are available". The launch overlay now carries sanitized copies of `~/.claude.json` and `.credentials.json` without the Console key and the claude.ai OAuth token (what the session changes, MCP tokens included, is merged back into your files on exit), drops `apiKeyHelper`, never writes the provider token to disk, and is built for every non-Anthropic launch, including local backends started without a model (#40, reported and diagnosed by @jeliseocd)

### Fixes
- `clother-kimi` sends its key as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, as Kimi Code documents, and targets the overseas host `api.kimi.ai`; the new `clother-kimi-cn` covers `api.kimi.com`
- `clother-deepseek` no longer uses `deepseek-chat`, discontinued on 2026-07-24: it follows DeepSeek's Claude Code guide (`deepseek-flash[1m]`, V4.1 Flash)
- `clother-ve` defaults to `ark-code-latest`: `doubao-seed-code` was retired on 2026-08-05
- `clother-alibaba-us` is removed: `coding-us.dashscope.aliyuncs.com` does not resolve and Alibaba has no US Coding Plan. A stale launcher now says so instead of "unknown profile"
- Every tier resolves to a provider model: `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL` is now set, and an unmapped tier no longer sends a Claude model ID to a third-party endpoint
- `--model opus|sonnet|haiku|fable` resolves through the provider's tier mapping instead of sending the alias to the provider
- The overlay reads the state file Claude Code actually uses: `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json` when it is set, a legacy `.config.json`, and the real config when a launcher starts from inside another Clother session
- `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK/VERTEX/FOUNDRY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` and context-size variables inherited from the shell no longer reroute third-party sessions
- Launchers recover when Claude Code's auto-updater prunes the version `claude-real` points to (based on #29 by @CurtisASmith)
- `clother bench` strips the `[1m]` suffix and authenticates like the launcher; `clother test` sends the configured credential
- `clother config` no longer loses answers when its input is piped
- llama.cpp gets a placeholder token like the other local backends, so Claude Code never falls back to an Anthropic login
- `clother --version` no longer prints a doubled `v` on release builds

### Features
- Model catalog refresh, checked against each vendor's Claude Code guide on 2026-09-22: Z.AI on GLM-5.3 with GLM-5.3-Flash for haiku (the plan only serves these two), MiniMax on `MiniMax-M3[1m]`, Moonshot on `kimi-k3[1m]`, DeepSeek on V4.1 Flash, Xiaomi MiMo on MiMo-V2.6 Pro, VolcEngine on the current plan models. 1M-context models carry the `[1m]` suffix and the vendor's auto-compact settings, so sessions are no longer compacted at 200K tokens
- New launchers: `kimi-cn`, `moonshot-cn`, `alibaba-token-plan` and `alibaba-token-plan-cn`
- LM Studio API token for servers with Require Authentication, stored in `secrets.env` (#37, requested by @Eponeshnikov)
- Default model and opus / sonnet / haiku mappings for Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp and custom providers, shown by `clother info` (#38, requested by @Eponeshnikov)

### Docs
- README: the `[1m]` suffix, tier aliases, the Alibaba Token Plan, region-bound keys, Ollama's 64K context and how Anthropic credentials are kept out of third-party sessions
